noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives a random number between "From" and "To", drawn again each time it is used. Connect it to a setting with the 🔗 button of the settings window.
noeuds.exemple: make a coin appear at a random X between 0 and 800.

noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives a value of the chosen object during the game: its x or y position, width, rotation, opacity…
noeuds.exemple: put a coin at the same height as the player (Y ← object value: player, y).

noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives the current value of a variable (score, lives…) during the game.
noeuds.exemple: show the score in a text (Text ← variable value: score).

noeuds.schema: Inputs: A, Operation, B  →  Output: none (end of script)
noeuds.role: Green node (value): calculates A + B, A − B, A × B or A ÷ B. A and B can be numbers, or receive a green wire themselves (chained calculations).
noeuds.exemple: give twice as many points (Value ← calculation: score × 2).

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object A, Object B  →  Output: none (end of script)
noeuds.role: Green node (value): gives the distance (in pixels) between the centers of two objects during the game.
noeuds.exemple: shake the screen harder when the enemy is close.
